## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- Carts are now saved for logged-out users for 30 days. (#211)
- Dark mode for the account page. (#217)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** The orders endpoint now returns prices in cents instead of decimal currency units. Clients that read order prices must be updated. (#214)

### Fixed
- Checkout total now applies the discount code on mobile. (#213)
- Search box no longer loses focus after the first letter is typed. (#215)
- Password reset links now expire. (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF.
- Invite teammates by email.

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Removed the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint.
- Switched the bundler to Vite.
- Documented the new invoice API in the README.

### Fixed
- VAT rounding on invoice totals ending in .5 now rounds correctly.
- Date picker showed the wrong month in Safari.

### Performance
- Search results load about twice as fast on large catalogues.

### Security
- Uploaded files could be read by other accounts. Access is now restricted to the owning account.

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Breaking Changes
- The config file was renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml`. Rename existing config files to `tool.toml` to keep your settings. (#41)

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command checks your setup. (#42)

### Fixed
- The `--quiet` flag no longer prints warnings. (#40)
- Fixed a crash on Windows paths that contain spaces. (#45)

### Security
- Upgraded the YAML parser to fix a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-4411). (#44)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Breaking Changes
- **Trips API now paginates by default, returning 50 trips per page.** Clients that expect every trip in a single response must now request additional pages. (#518)

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips. (#515)
- Share a trip with a link that expires. (#519)

### Changed
- Removed the legacy trip importer. (#524)

### Fixed
- Edits made while offline are no longer lost after logging in. (#517)
- Map pins no longer overlap on small screens. (#521)

### Security
- Shared links no longer expose the owner's email address. (#522)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Breaking Changes
- Dropped support for Internet Explorer 11. (#93)

### Added
- Spell check for 14 languages in the editor. (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown. (#91)
- Produce arm64 builds. (#88)

### Fixed
- Undo skipped every second change in the editor. (#89)
- Session tokens are no longer written to the browser console. (#90)
- Tables pasted from Excel no longer lose their borders. (#94)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Breaking Changes
- Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month.

### Added
- Subscriptions can be paused for up to 3 months.

### Fixed
- Receipt emails showed the wrong currency symbol.
- CSV export no longer cuts off rows after 10,000.

### Security
- Webhook signatures are now verified, and forged webhooks are rejected.
